The Oregon knowledge test

  • 35 multiple-choice questions.
  • You need 28 correct answers to pass (80%).
  • The state also gives the test in Spanish.

Practice questions

160 practice questions for Oregon: 31 about Oregon rules and 129 about signs, signals and markings that are the same in every state. Free: every question, hints and read-aloud. No sign-up.

Languages

  • Every question: English, Español.
  • The 129 national questions (signs, signals, road markings) also in 中文, Tiếng Việt, Tagalog, العربية. In these languages the Oregon questions show in English for now.

5 sample questions

1. In Oregon, what is the youngest age to get an instruction permit?

  1. 14 years old
  2. 15 years old (correct answer)
  3. 16 years old
  4. 17 years old

Answer: B. In Oregon you can get an instruction permit at 15.

Oregon handbook, page 89.

2. In Oregon, may a driver under 18 talk on a cell phone with a hands-free device?

  1. No, not even hands-free (correct answer)
  2. Yes, hands-free is always allowed
  3. Yes, but only on highways
  4. Yes, but only during the day

Answer: A. In Oregon, a driver under 18 may not use a cell phone while driving, not even with a hands-free device.

Oregon handbook, page 80.

3. In Oregon, you approach a stopped emergency vehicle with lights flashing and cannot change lanes safely. What must you do?

  1. Keep your speed
  2. Stop in your lane
  3. Slow to at least 5 mph below the posted speed (correct answer)
  4. Speed up to pass quickly

Answer: C. In Oregon, if you cannot safely move over, you must slow to at least 5 mph below the posted speed.

4. In Oregon, you are turning at an intersection with a traffic light. A person is crossing the street you are turning into. When may you start your turn?

  1. As soon as the person reaches the center line
  2. When the person is 2 feet from your car
  3. When your light turns green, no matter where the person is
  4. When the person is at least 6 feet from the lane you are turning into (correct answer)

Answer: D. In Oregon, at an intersection with a traffic light, you may start your turn only when the person is at least 6 feet from the lane you are turning into.

Oregon handbook, page 47.

5. In Oregon, how old must the licensed person beside a permit driver be?

  1. At least 16
  2. At least 18
  3. At least 21 (correct answer)
  4. At least 30

Answer: C. An Oregon permit driver must have a licensed person who is at least 21 years old in the seat beside them.

Oregon handbook, page 90.
